Welcome to Hollycombe Primary School
Message from the Headteacher
I am proud to be the Headteacher of Hollycombe School. We have a wonderful location, a fantastic staff team and supportive, engaged families with polite, cheerful and happy children. Our school rules are few: be safe, be responsible, be respectful. In lessons our learning code is 'listen, join in, keep going'. Our enthusiastic and hard-working children show us all every day how they live up to these high standards. We would love you to visit and see our school in action, if you are are considering joining us. We show families around our school most weeks: get in touch if you would like to visit.
Miss Louise Franklin
Miss Louise Franklin
Headteacher

Wrap-Around Care
Breakfast Club (7.45-8.45am) is run daily by CM Sports. Games and activities plus a healthy breakfast! For all enquiries please go to www.cm-sports.co.uk
Hub Club (3.10-4.15/5pm) is run daily by Lisa Taylor - games and craft activities plus outdoor sessions in the garden, and a biscuit snack! To enquire about places please contact Lisa at thehubclub@gmx.com or phone her on 07795 495555. For any ‘on the day’ queries please call the school office during school hours until 3pm, and after 3pm contact Lisa direct on her mobile number.

Curriculum
Our curriculum is derived from the National Curriculum that all Local Authority maintained schools in England follow.
We customise the curriculum to reflect our local context and our school's history: particularly our rural location, our love of the countryside and the natural world, our engineering heritage.
